## Summary

A one-sentence description of the feature.

## Problem it solves

What is the current limitation or pain point? Who does it affect?

## Proposed solution

Describe the change you'd like to see. Be as specific as possible — which endpoints, components, or contract functions would change?

## Which layer does this touch?

- [ ] Smart contract (`contract/`)
- [ ] Backend API (`backend/`)
- [ ] Frontend UI (`frontend/`)
- [ ] Documentation

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about and why you prefer this one.

## Additional context

Mockups, diagrams, links to related issues or prior art.
